verdict.line: You lose if you auto-trade into her empowered Q before your E stun is ready; you win if you force an all-in off a missed Hookshot or her down ultimate.

brief.thesis: This is a 50% win rate over 2339 games because both champions are melee skirmishers whose damage is gated behind a single cooldown — her Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto, your E (Facebreaker) stun. Whoever lands their gated tool first wins the exchange, and the data's solo-kill edge toward Sett says you win more all-ins than she does once you close the gap. The matchup is decided by positioning around walls and stun angles, not raw stats.

tell.watch: Her Q empower window / your W Grit

theirWindow.when: her Q (Precision Protocol) auto is primed
theirWindow.what: She'll walk up for the empowered hit and gets bonus Move Speed on landing it — if you see the Q buff icon, back off one step rather than trading face-first, or you eat the bonus damage and then get kited by the speed boost.

yourWindow.when: her E (Hookshot) is down after a miss or reposition
yourWindow.what: Hookshot only works off a wall and is on a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown — once it's spent she has no disengage. Use Q's move speed toward her to close distance and land E (Facebreaker) for the stun before she can reset to a wall.

start.why: 81.5% pick rate and the higher win rate (50.2% over 2229 games) — the extra sustain lets you keep matching her auto-trades without losing the lane to attrition.

boots.why: 68.7% pick rate at 50.2% win — Camille's damage is almost entirely in empowered basic attacks, so flat armor directly blunts her Q auto and passive-shielded trades.

core.why: The near-universal first item in the data — the active gives you the gap-close to actually reach her before she resets with Hookshot.
Part of the highest-sample core path (60.1% win over 368 games); the armor shred compounds with Steelcaps against her auto-reliant kit.
Closes out the most-picked build path and gives sustain for the extended skirmishes this matchup turns into post-6.

situational.when: if she's ahead in damage and you need to survive her burst to land your own combo
if the game is going long and fights are decided by who outlasts, not who burst first (63.2% win rate over the smaller 76-game sample)
if you're ahead on kills and want to snowball cooldown uptime on E

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained-trade, multi-hit nature of this matchup — stacks build through autos and your E stun window rather than needing a single burst.

summoners.why: 91.2% pick rate at 50.1% win — the matchup's aggressive shape and Sett's solo-kill edge are best converted with Ignite punishing her all-in attempts or her passive sustain shield.

playing.title: Hold trades until E is up
playing.detail: Your real damage lands in the E (Facebreaker) stun window, not the auto exchange. Don't commit to a long trade just because her Q is on cooldown — wait for your stun to be up too.

playing.title: Track your own W Grit bar
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) passively banks damage you take as Grit and expends it on cast for a shield plus true damage center and physical damage on the sides. Tank a hit or two before casting so the shield is actually large when you need it.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Hookshot
playing.detail: Camille's E only functions off a wall and sits on a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown. The moment she whiffs or has no wall to use it on, close with Q's bonus move speed and force the fight.

playing.title: Save R for isolated picks
playing.detail: The Show Stopper carries her through the air and slams her, slowing everyone near the landing spot — use it to drag her off a wall or back to your jungler rather than as a lane poke.

playing.title: Respect her ultimate timer
playing.detail: Hextech Ultimatum anchors you to her for its duration and is on a long 140/115/90s cooldown pre-16. Play riskier the moment you know it's down; play around positioning near her once it's up.

playing.title: Break her passive shield first
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses gives Camille a shield off her own autos. Open your combo with Q (Knuckle Down)'s empowered hits to burn through that shield before your real damage lands.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1) — the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers come out even is this brief's own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Camille’s (E). Use your abilities off cooldown to close in and fight her. Use [W] when Camille uses (Q).
